subject: Request: 3yr price lock + renewal protection for Nebula (DEAL-2028-0921)
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 3yr price lock + renewal protection for Nebula (DEAL-2028-0921)

Team — quick context: Nebula (trial -> production) is asking for a 3-year commercial with two non-standard asks that push past our deal desk guardrails. I need an exec opinion to move forward before I involve Procurement/legal in earnest.

Summary of asks from customer (Eleanor Wu):
- 3-year term on Hosted API with a price lock for the term; they want an annual uplift cap of 8% (we currently allow 5% standard).
- Renewal protection clause: limit step-ups at renewal to a maximum of 10% compared to expiring term and right to negotiate otherwise — they want protection vs. a large increase at renewal.
- They are committing to a $1.2M ARR equivalent promise in year 1 and want a 22% discount off list for the commit.

Why this needs exec review: 22% + price lock + uplift cap combination exceeds our normal authorized discount/term tradeoffs and could set precedent. Finance/ops asked I surface margin impact and whether we accept proposed uplift cap + renewal protection.

Attachments: pricing_matrix_Q2_v1.pdf (shows margin scenarios), proposed_T&C_redlines.docx (customer redlines).

Asks:
1) Approve/disapprove multi-year price lock with uplift cap 8% and renewal protection as negotiated.
2) If approve, any required guardrails (e.g., minimum ARR, commit language, auto-fallback to alternate SKU if usage > X)?

I recommend approval with tighter uplift cap (6%) and an explicit auto-fallback to our dedicated pricing if token volumes exceed projected thresholds. If we do 22% discount, we should require a 12-month minimum commitment or onboarding milestone-based credit release.

Can you reply with your position? I will route to Laura for final sign-off if we reach internal consensus.

Thanks,
Dylan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pricing_matrix_Q2_v1.pdf]
[Attachment: proposed_T&C_redlines.docx]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: 3yr price lock + renewal protection for Nebula (DEAL-2028-0921)

Agree with Dylan's assessment. High-level notes from a sales perspective:
- Nebula is strategic in healthcare; they bring strong reference value in regional hospital networks.
- 22% is near the top of what I'd approve with a 1yr+ commit; for 3yr we should ask for an escalation clause tied to ARR and adoption milestones (e.g., 6 months live, 12 months usage milestones).
- Uplift cap at 8% is reasonable from a customer POV but cuts our flexibility at renewal — prefer 6% as a compromise.

Suggested language to operationalize:
- Price lock for 36 months provided customer meets quarterly adoption milestones (simple usage KPIs).
- Annual uplift capped at 6% (not 8%), explicit carve-out that major infrastructure cost changes (GPU price shocks) allow us to re-open pricing with 90 days' notice.

If finance wants to keep it tight, we can alternatively do a 24-month lock + option to renew at defined step, which reduces risk.

--Marissa
Senior Sales Manager
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Apr 2028 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 3yr price lock + renewal protection for Nebula (DEAL-2028-0921)

Financial take (very quick):
- Scenario with 22% discount + price lock + uplift cap 8% -> NRR risk on renewal; modeled NPV reduction vs. list of ~18% over 3 yrs (assumes flat usage).
- If we tighten uplift to 6% and add milestone release (e.g., 30% of discount unlocked at 12 months), our NPV loss drops to ~11%.
- We should insist on a performance-based clawback if usage < 60% of forecast in any rolling 12-month window. That protects unit economics and signals seriousness.

I don't object to approving with these guardrails. If leadership wants to push deeper, require a revenue commitment escrow or prepay structure.

-Ben
Director, Revenue Operations
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Apr 2028 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 3yr price lock + renewal protection for Nebula (DEAL-2028-0921)

Couple of legal/ops flags to surface before forwarding to Laura:
- "Renewal protection" language must be precise — we can limit increases to X% but cannot bind future pricing forever; recommend language: "At renewal, Seller will not increase Base Prices by more than 10% over the immediately preceding 12-month average without Customer's written consent."
- Add auto-fallback clause: if monthly token volume > 150% of committed base for 3 consecutive months, Redwood may transition the account to a usage-tiered pricing or dedicated SKU with 60 days notice. This protects us from runaway consumption.
- Ensure indemnities and data processing addendum align with 3-year term; legal will want DocuSign with explicit milestone attachments.

If internal OK on uplift cap (6%) + milestone/clawback language, I'm fine forwarding to Laura for exec approval.

-Jonas
Head of Deal Desk Operations

Laura — forwarding the thread and attachments. TL;DR: Nebula wants 3yr price lock + 8% uplift cap + renewal protection and 22% off list. Internal recs: tighten uplift to 6%, milestone-based discount release, and a clawback if usage falls below forecast. Jonas has redlined renewal language and an auto-fallback to a different SKU if consumption surges.

Attachments again: pricing_matrix_Q2_v1.pdf, proposed_T&C_redlines.docx

Can you please advise whether this combination is approvable at your level or if it requires Exec Committee sign-off? If approveable, please confirm any edits to uplift cap or additional guardrails we should demand.

Thanks,
Dylan
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 29 Apr 2028 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: 3yr price lock + renewal protection for Nebula (DEAL-2028-0921)

Reviewed — I approve with the following mandatory conditions:
1) Set the annual uplift cap at 6% (not 8%).
2) Require milestone-based discount release: 30% of the total discount released after 12 months if usage >= 75% of forecast; 40% after 24 months, remainder at 36 months.
3) Add a performance clawback if rolling 12-month usage < 60% of committed volume: pro-rata repayment of discounts over prior 12 months.
4) Include the auto-fallback clause Jonas suggested (transition to dedicated SKU/usage pricing with 60 days' notice) and an explicit carve-out for major infrastructure cost inflation with 90 days' notice.

With those conditions I authorize the Deal Desk to finalize economic terms and hand to legal for signature. Please ensure the final DocuSign packet includes the milestone schedule and a simple recovery schedule for clawbacks.

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue & GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
